_comment: Synced Search Console + Bing rows in the signatures the local route reads: gsc_daily is the GSC date-only rollup (daily, 3-day final lag, ends 2026-08-26); gsc_query / gsc_page are the GSC per-query and per-page slices (WEEKLY rows dated Mondays, 13 weeks); bing_query is the Bing per-query slice (weekly, 26 weeks - Bing writes NO rollup, so its daily totals are the per-date SUM of these). The previous 90 days ran hotter than the current 90 on GSC; Bing is flat. Nothing in this file names a GBP defect.
